ordered_progress_attribution.scope: Full factual ordered milestones, using the existing episode_progress definition. The switch observation is pre-switch. New later milestones are descriptive, not proof of causal benefit; compare the declared references. A whole-episode violation removes progress eligibility. Physical verification is consumed, not repeated. No prefix termination or automatic next-stage authority.

episodes.scope: Executed +/-1 inputs are opening/closing commands, not achieved finger motion. Positions are the two measured joint coordinates at native query instants, not fingertip aperture or a continuous motion record. Command index t acts before observation t+1. Query positions at the switch are measured before the first native action and are excluded from strictly-after statistics. Raw holding/closure counts include unsafe observations and earn no credit. No physical grasp-link or causal benefit is inferred from these counts.
